feeds.title: World Cetacean Alliance
feeds.description: World's largest partnership for whales and dolphins. Partners are NGOs big and small, whalewatching companies and individuals. Join us as we will seek innovative and positive solutions to the issues affecting cetaceans by adopting an inclusive, solutions-driven approach at all times.

feeds.title: Prince of Whales
feeds.description: An innovative leader in the eco-tourism industry, Alan McGillivray, the founder of Prince of Whales, started this company in 1994 with one small boat that was used to deliver newspaper and mail bundles to the Gulf Islands in the morning and to take people whale watching in the afternoon. Get insights from the largest, SAFEST, most reliable whale watching company in Victoria BC.

feeds.title: Island Adventures Whale Report
feeds.description: Island Adventures Whale Report. Find information on whales and whale watching.

feeds.title: San Diego Whale Watch
feeds.description: San Diego's FIRST year round whale and dolphin watching experience! We embark on 3-hour trips aboard the Privateer in the search for a variety of marine animals. We often see sea lions, seals, a variety of birds, dolphins, and different species of whales depending on the time of year. Follow us to ensure our community is able to experience our wildlife year round while learning something along the way.

feeds.title: California Whale Watching
feeds.description: The Santa Barbara Channel offers some of the finest whale and dolphin watching in the world. Follow us to view gray, humpback and blue whales, dolphins, orcas, seals and sea lions along the coast and at the Channel Islands. Gray whales pass along the cost during their annual migration every winter and spring.

feeds.title: The Whale Sanctuary Project - Back to Nature
feeds.description: We're building a model sanctuary where captive whales and dolphins can be rehabilitated and live permanently in their natural environment. Join us to get updates on The Whale Sanctuary Project to establish a model seaside sanctuary where cetaceans (porpoises, dolphins and whales) can live permanently in an environment that maximizes well-being and autonomy and is as close as possible to their natural habitat.

feeds.title: Orca Spirit Adventures - Victoria and Vancouver Whale Watching
feeds.description: The Captains Blog share the latest sightings of whales around Victoria and Vancouver as well as other news about Orcas, habitat, the environment and more.

feeds.title: Whale and Dolphin Conservation UK
feeds.description: WDC is the leading global charity dedicated to the conservation and protection of whales and dolphins, working towards a world where every whale and dolphin is safe and free. Find out what is happening in the world of whales and dolphins with views and opinions from Whale and Dolphin Conservation and other experts in the field.

feeds.title: Whale and Dolphin Conservation USA Blog
feeds.description: Whale and Dolphin Conservation is dedicated solely to the worldwide conservation and welfare of all whales, dolphins and porpoises. Find out what is happening in the world of whales and dolphins with views and opinions from Whale and Dolphin Conservation and other experts in the field.

feeds.title: Hebridean Whale & Dolphin Trust
feeds.description: Hebridean Whale and Dolphin Trust (HWDT) is a marine conservation charity that takes action through a unique programme of community based research and education. Follow us as we conduct the research that underpins the future safeguarding of whales, dolphins and porpoises.

feeds.title: Western Prince Whale Watching - Whale Watching San Juan Island
feeds.description: We run whale watching and wildlife tours in the San Juan Islands, north of Seattle, Washington. We focus on offering high quality, intimate tours, guided by dedicated local naturalists. We may also encounter beautiful Humpback Whales and Minke Whales. Check out Western Prince Whale Watching Tours blog for the latest updates from Friday Harbor, San Juan Island. Located 90 miles north of Seattle, Washington

feeds.title: Elding Whale Watching Akureyri
feeds.description: Whale Watching Akureyri offers whale watching tours in comfortable sightseeing ships and custom made small RIB boats. We represent Elding and Whale Safari. Experience The Eyjafjord Humpbacks! Whale Watching from Akureyri in North Iceland. Follow our blogs to get updates on latest whale watching tours.

feeds.title: Dyer Island Cruises - Whale Watching South Africa
feeds.description: Whale watching in Cape Town, Hermanus, South Africa. Whale watching is seasonal, our whale watching trips are weather depended. We like to keep our friends and guests up to date with all that's going on with Dyer Island Cruises.

feeds.title: Searcher Natural History Tours - Baja Whales
feeds.description: Whalewatching, pelagic birding, and wildlife weekends in Southern California and Baja California. Find articles on whale watching, gray, blue, fin, humpback, sperm, Bryde's, and pilot whales; while many more whales and dolphins are possible

feeds.title: Whale of A 'Purpose'
feeds.description: COME WHALE AWAY WITH ME!! Sharing my killer whale encounters with you. Whether from shore or a boat, I'll bring the whales to you no matter where you live.

feeds.title: Southern Right Charters - Hermanus Whale Watching Blog
feeds.description: A blog detailing everything you need to know about Hermanus whale watching, and marine conservation in South Africa.

feeds.title: North Sailing
feeds.description: North Sailing was one of the first companies in Iceland to offer regular whale watching tours. From the beginning, North Sailing has been dedicated to preserving old oak ships. Offering frequent departures, highly qualified crews and a dedication to sustainable and nature friendly operations, North Sailing is your perfect choice. Follow our blog to see whales and news of our whale watching tours.

feeds.title: San Juan Safaris Whale Watching
feeds.description: Whale Watching & Wildlife Tours, Friday Harbor, San Juan Island WA near Seattle since 1994. The San Juan Safaris Whale Report brings to you trip reports from the Salish Sea. San Juan Safaris sees more whales than anyone departing from Friday Harbor near Seattle.

feeds.title: Seattle Orca Whale Watching
feeds.description: Partners with San Juan Safaris and Kenmore Air for the best whale watch tour in the San Juans. An amazing Orca whale watching tour is just a short drive from Seattle. Find the latest news and information for Seattle Orca Whale Watching & San Juan Safaris

feeds.title: Great Whale Conservancy Blog
feeds.description: Protecting the world's great whales and their habitat. For many decades, Earth's Great Whales have needed an organization exclusively dedicated to generating awareness, motivating the public, and steering the public's involvement towards saving whales. Find reat Whale Conservancy Latest Videos Latest Great Whale Conservancy Updates GWC Around The World

feeds.title: Futurismo - Azores Whale Watching
feeds.description: The Azores islands are famous for being one of the hottest spots in the world for cetacean observation. Discover this secret islands with Futurismo Azores Whale Watching and follow our blog to see dolphins and whales, with special emphasis on the resident sperm whales.

feeds.title: Maya's Legacy Whale Watching
feeds.description: Maya's Legacy Whale Watching provides intimate, small group whale watching tours in the San Juan Islands, Washington. Read the latest updates and view photos and videos from our whale watching & wildlife tours departing from Friday Harbor, San Juan Island, Washington.

feeds.title: Láki Tours Blog
feeds.description: Iceland blog with news about Láki Tours, articles about whale watching in Iceland, photos and videos of very special tours and much more.

feeds.title: Majestic Whale Encounters
feeds.description: Majestic Whale Encounters is one of the most unique whale swim tour operators in the world. Their soul purpose is to take our guests on a journey to swim with whales in Tonga, Tahiti or Norway for the experience of a lifetime.

feeds.title: Whale Research
feeds.description: The Center for Whale Research is a non profit organization that dedicated to the long term study and conservation of killer whales in Western Washington State and British Columbia. Find information on collected detailed demographic data on the Southern Resident killer whale population, recording all observed births and deaths.

feeds.title: Geospatial Ecology of Marine Megafauna Laboratory | New Zealand Blue Whales
feeds.description: Geospatial Ecology of Marine Megafauna Lab at Oregon State University. Headed by Dr. Leigh Torres. Find insights on New Zealand Blue Whales Blog.

feeds.title: Harbor Breeze Cruises
feeds.description: Harbor Breeze Cruises offers daily whale watching and harbor cruises in addition to boat charters for special occasions such as weddings, reunions, birthday parties, Catalina transportation, fishing, marine science labs and more! Learn about the different kinds of whales and recent sightings from our crew with the Harbor Breeze Whale Watching Blog.

feeds.title: Lobosonda Blog
feeds.description: We stand for Water, Whales, Whale Watching, Whale conservation, Wellness and for Welcome. Lobosonda is a whale watching company respectful of all marine biodiversity operating in Madeira since 2003. Check out the amazing stories and photos we collect every day.

feeds.title: Whale & Dolphin Conservation Australia
feeds.description: WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation is dedicated to the conservation and protection of all whales and dolphins in Australia and worldwide.

feeds.title: Whale Watch Kaikoura
feeds.description: New Zealand's only vessel based whale watching company offering an exciting up-close encounter with the Giant Sperm Whale all year round. Keep up-to-date with the latest news at Whale Watch Kaikoura, including rare sightings, our monthly summary and other interesting events in Kaikoura.

feeds.title: Princess Monterey Whale Watching
feeds.description: Princess Monterey Whale Watching has been in the cruise business for over 30 years. We are Monterey Bay's leading company in narrated ocean and bay tours, specializing in natural history and biology of marine wildlife, especially whales! Get information on natural history and biology of marine wildlife, we have a healthy respect and appreciation of ocean conservation and the bay.

feeds.title: Five Star Whale Watching
feeds.description: Victoria Whale Watching. Longest running & most respected Victoria Whale Watching company! Environmentally friendly & responsible whale watching. Follow us on our journey to whale watching.
